fact: Gyrgum hands Stool to Thorin because Stool can only move 10 feet and Gyrgum cannot carry him far due to 8 Strength.
source_quote: Stool could move only 10 feet, and Gyrgum, with 8 Strength, could not carry him far. So Gyrgum handed Stool up to Thorin
subject: Stool carried by Thorin

fact: Stool grabs onto Thorin for dear life while being carried.
source_quote: Stool "grabs onto you for dear life."
subject: Stool

fact: Stool releases rapport spores to create a telepathic link between the party members.
source_quote: Stool released a cloud of rapport spores that wove a telepathic link between them
subject: Rapport spores released

fact: Zalthir uses both his action and bonus action to dash, sprinting ahead of the main group.
source_quote: Zalthir used both his action and bonus action to dash, sprinting ahead of the main group.
subject: Zalthir dashes

fact: Zalthir rolls a 17 on a search of the rocky terrain and finds a natural alcove.
source_quote: He searched the rocky terrain on a roll of 17 and found a natural alcove
subject: Zalthir finds alcove

fact: The natural alcove found by Zalthir gives the party advantage on their stealth check.
source_quote: found a natural alcove that would give the whole party advantage on its stealth check.
subject: Natural alcove

fact: Gyrgum dashes to the hiding place, moving 30 feet plus a bonus-action Dash.
source_quote: Gyrgum moves 30 feet plus a bonus-action Dash
subject: Gyrgum dashes

fact: Gyrgum gains two temporary hit points from his Adrenaline Rush trait.
source_quote: gains two temporary hit points from Adrenaline Rush (his orc trait).
subject: Gyrgum gains temp HP

fact: Gyrgum uses Thaumaturgy to make the ground tremble.
source_quote: used Thaumaturgy to set the ground trembling
subject: Gyrgum casts Thaumaturgy

fact: The drow scouts encounter a sudden drop in the tunnel floor.
source_quote: The drow hit a sudden drop in the tunnel
subject: Drow hit drop

fact: The drow scouts make their Dexterity save and avoid falling into the pit.
source_quote: but made their Dexterity save and avoided the hole.
subject: Drow scouts

fact: Daz dashes into the hiding spot.
source_quote: Daz dashed into the hiding spot
subject: Daz hides

fact: The party's group stealth check against DC 12 holds, causing the scouts to lose the scent.
source_quote: The party's group stealth check against DC 12 held, and the scouts lost the scent.
subject: Group stealth check

fact: The drow scouts double back and disappear down a different corridor.
source_quote: The scouts doubled back and disappeared down a different corridor
subject: Drow scouts

fact: Thorin states he is at minus one on stealth.
source_quote: Thorin warns he is at minus one on stealth.
subject: Thorin

fact: Zalthir warns the party they must move faster to prevent the Drow from catching up.
source_quote: Zalthir reminded them... that they needed to move faster and keep moving
subject: Zalthir

fact: The GM explains that a participant can Dash 3 + CON modifier times.
source_quote: A participant can Dash 3 + CON modifier times.
subject: Chase rules explanation

fact: Each extra Dash beyond the limit requires a DC 10 CON save or the runner gains a level of exhaustion.
source_quote: Each extra Dash requires a DC 10 CON save or the runner gains a level of exhaustion.
subject: Chase exhaustion rule

fact: The scouts roll a 12 on initiative.
source_quote: The scouts roll 12 on initiative (8 + 2).
subject: Scouts initiative

fact: The GM adjusts the distance gap between the party and scouts to 160 feet.
source_quote: the GM worked the gap out to 160 feet
subject: Distance gap adjusted
